posts.text:
Our office attended the Novant Healthcare Ribbon Cutting in Nexton, and met with Novant President Kirsten Royster.

At their new facility, they will provide primary care, women's health services including OB/GYN, maternal fetal medicine, weight loss, and surgical care to the Summerville area. 

South Carolina STRONG.
There should be no recess until TSA is paid.

The safety of every American is our top priority. 

American civilians in the region need to get home, and our troops need to stay off the ground. Both are non-negotiable.

Video

TSA agents show up every single day to keep American travelers safe. They don't deserve their paychecks being held hostage. President Trump made sure it didn't happen.

The House passed a bill to support full funding for DHS. Every Republican voted yes. Over 95% of Democrats voted no, choosing to sacrifice TSA paychecks for politics.

The Left fights harder to protect illegal immigrants than to fund hardworking Americans. Thank you, President Trump, for always putting American workers first.
Congress shouldn’t recess until TSA is funded.
So far, the Epstein files have exposed one thing clearly: in this country, the rich and powerful play by a completely different set of rules.

We authored an op-ed on our resolution to force public release of Congressional sexual harassment records and how 357 members on both sides of the aisle teamed up to kill it.

These are the same people who stand at podiums claiming to protect women. The same ones posing for photos during awareness months. The same voices demanding accountability and transparency.

Then came the vote. They chose to cover it up.

Read the full piece here: newsweek.com/nancy-mace-sexu…
Sending prayers and well wishes to Joe Wilson following his fall. Hoping for a quick recovery and back to serving South Carolina soon. God bless.

Sending U.S. troops into harm's way is not a decision we take lightly. Right now, we’re not convinced it’s necessary, and we will not support it.

Video

Traveling abroad soon?✈️

Spring break and summer are right around the corner, now is the time to check your passport.

Many countries require your passport to be valid for at least six months beyond your return date. Don’t let an expired passport ruin your plans.

If you need assistance or have questions about your passport, our office is here to help. 

See More: mace.house.gov/services/pass…
